description: FloatCurve semantics. FloatCurve.Load/Add/Evaluate are KSP's own code (direct); the UnityEngine.AnimationCurve underneath is the harness's managed port of Unity 2019.4.18f1's native AnimationCurveTpl<float> (KspUnityShim), transcribed op-for-op from UnityPlayer.dll disassembly with Unity's public PDB symbols (re-hosted native; not executed natively). Values are float32. Sample times include every key time, the float32 neighbours of every key time, segment midpoints and a uniform grid extending 10% beyond the key range on both sides.
oracles: rehosted-native: AnimationCurveTpl<float>::Evaluate / CalculateCacheData / FindIndexForSampling / AddKey / AddKeySmoothTangents / RecalculateSplineSlopeT (UnityPlayer.dll 2019.4.18f1)

provenance.float_semantics: IEEE-754 binary32/binary64, SSE2 (RyuJIT x64); libm from the .NET Framework CLR, not Unity's Mono
